messages.text: Hello good day hope you're doing well I just wanted to reach out and see if my minor was shipped out yet if not I was looking to purchase one right now and maybe add it to the shipping before it goes out my order number is Shop····
I'll look that up.

I've got the order number. To open it up I just need one thing that matches it: the email on the order, or the postcode ····to. Whichever's easier.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Read the bitfortun bs 4 page

Thanks, Jeffery, that matches. Your BS-4 hasn't shipped yet, but it's right at the edge: it finished final testing and leaves the manufacturer today, so I can't add anything to that box.

A second BS-4 bought now is a separate order anyway, the current listing ships November 30. I can't combine the two shipments, but it won't cost you extra to have them go separately.

Want me to check anything else before you order the second one?
Okay sounds good how do I select different colors the second one I want to black one
Searched the catalog · Bitfortun BS-4 18TH/s

There's no colour option on the BS-4, Jeffery. The only choice on the listing is the AC plug, and that's matched to your address automatically, so Canada gets the right cord. The unit ships in the white finish you see in the photos, at $599.99.

If you've seen a black one somewhere, tell me where and I'll ask the team whether that's a version we can get.

Yeah on the listing on the website it shows the white one and a black one for some reason but there's no option to pick but yeah if we can make the second one the black one that would be great the first one white
Handed to the team · No colour variant exists on the product; whether a black BS-4 can be ordered fro

You're right, the photos show both, but there's no colour to pick at checkout, so I can't put a black one through myself.

I've asked the team whether the black BS-4 is something we can actually order for you. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here shortly, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.

Don't buy the second one yet, let's get that confirmed first.
Thanks for your help placing order now

Sounds good. Order it as normal, it'll come through as the standard white unit, listed ship date November 30.

If the team comes back saying black is possible, let me know and I'll see what can be done on that new order before it goes out. Drop me the new order number once it's placed.
Oh

Yeah, November 30 is the date on the BS-4 listing right now, so a new one wouldn't arrive with the first.

Was it the date that threw you, or the colour? Tell me which and I'll work with it.
No all good I just had a co-worker that really wanted one I just thought maybe I could have this one thrown on the ship mint so he gets it sooner he would like the black one if possible
Handed to the team · Needs a person: adding a paid unit to a dropship order already leaving the manuf

Got it, that makes sense. Your unit is leaving the manufacturer today, so I can't add a second one to it myself.

I've put both questions to the team: whether a second BS-4 can still join that shipment, and whether it can be the black one. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in, or the answer reaches your email if you step away. Don't place the second order until they come back.
No worries

Thanks for being patient with it. Your own BS-4 is on the move today, and you'll get tracking by email as soon as it leaves.

One thing I'm curious about while we wait: what made you go for the BS-4 over the smaller units? Water cooling, or the 18 TH/s?
Just seemed like a good comfortable price point with the TH and it looks pretty sweet

Fair call, 18 TH/s at that price is hard to beat in the lineup, and it is a good looking unit.

Where's it going to live, somewhere you'll hear it? At about 50 dB the water cooling keeps it fairly tame, but it's not silent in a bedroom.
Work on a drilling rig there's constant background noise it honestly probably help us sleep

Ha, then 50 dB won't register at all on a rig.

One thing worth knowing for that setup: it runs on 2.4 GHz wifi or ethernet, so if the camp wifi is spotty, a cable is the safer bet for 24/7 uptime.

The team will come back here on the black unit and the shipment question. Anything else I can sort while you wait?
No thank you

Happy to help, Jeffery. The team will come back in here on the black unit and whether a second one can join the shipment, and a copy of this whole chat lands in your email once we're done.

You're welcome to join our Discord too, it's where the hands-on help and new product news live: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Awesome
Enjoy the BS-4 when it lands, and good luck on the rig. Take care.
